For the past decade I have done the same job in different settings: take something that does not exist yet, get it in front of real users, and build the team that keeps it running.

I built a marketplace from scratch inside Tata's super-app. I worked on routing algorithms at a logistics SaaS company that IKEA acquired. Now I lead product for LiteFarm, a farm management platform run out of UBC.
I have been the official manager of my team in each of my last three roles. That makes me responsible for the roadmap and for whether people grow, stay, and enjoy working together.
